channel.title: Business Insider France - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Business Insider France (businessinsider.fr)

item.title: I took my first solo trip to Iceland. It didn't transform me, but it did wonders for my anxiety levels and confidence.
item.description: Anxiety held me back from traveling alone for years, but I finally faced my fears with my first solo trip to Iceland. It helped build my confidence.

item.title: The Enola Gay dropped the atomic bomb on Hiroshima in World War II. Here's where the plane is now.
item.description: The Enola Gay, the plane that dropped the atomic bomb on Hiroshima in World War II, is now a museum exhibit.

item.title: How real Pecorino Romano cheese Is made In Lazio, Italy
item.description: In this episode, we visit I Buonatavola, one of the very last producers still making Pecorino Romano in Lazio.

item.title: My 15-year-old is training for the 2034 Olympics. We are considering looking for financial sponsors for him.
item.description: A mom shares what it's like raising a teenage ski athlete in the US Ski Team pipeline and the family sacrifices required along the way.

item.title: Trump now says he will raise 'worldwide' tariff from 10% to 15%
item.description: President Donald Trump is not giving up on his tariff strategy.

item.title: I have the best talks with my preteen son when I drive him to school in the morning. I hope he knows I'm always here for him.
item.description: A mom explains how everyday car rides became the most meaningful way to stay connected to her son as he entered his tween years.

item.title: Big Tech wants more data centers. Residents in this New Jersey city said not here.
item.description: Residents cheered when a New Jersey city decided to remove data centers from its redevelopment plan. Data centers are now a flash point in many towns.

item.title: Sam Altman says Elon Musk's idea of putting data centers in space is 'ridiculous'
item.description: While in New Delhi on Friday, OpenAI CEO Sam Altman said "there will come a time" for orbital data centers, but it won't be anytime soon.

item.title: Elite investment bank settles case that put Wall Street's 100-hour weeks on trial
item.description: Centerview Partners has reached a settlement with a former analyst just before a trial was set to begin over its grueling 100-hour workweeks.

item.title: Trump demands Netflix fire former national security advisor Susan Rice from its board
item.description: Donald Trump weighed in amid negotiations over the Warner Bros. deal, saying Netflix should fire Susan Rice from its board "or pay the consequences."
